note: write-once per session. The derivatives venue pays funding hourly, and its API compacts those hourly events into one calendar-day row stamped 00:00:00 UTC once they age. This book's session closes at 21:00 UTC, so a calendar-day aggregate cannot be split at the boundary and the 21:00-24:00 slice silently migrates to the previous session -- measured 2026-09-20, 0.366514 USD moved from 2026-09-11 into 2026-09-10 with the code untouched. The realised P&L of the derivatives leg is therefore frozen here the first time a session is published, and never re-read, so a published record never changes value when the venue re-buckets its own history
